description: CoffeeDateNow is an 18+ real-time meetup app that shows you adults nearby who are free for coffee right now. No endless swiping — just say yes, get matched, and pick a public café. Powered by an MCP server, ChatGPT can help users find available matches, suggest nearby cafés, and facilitate spontaneous in-person coffee dates.
